summary: Converts floating-point vertex colors to a packed 32-bit format under a texture/vertex encoder object. Optionally reformats the input vertex buffer via DirectXVertexBufferFormatConversion when a format flag is set, then addresses a block of vertex data from field +0x2C using two 2-bit block coordinates. Each vertex's R/G/B channels are scaled (512.0 for the red quant scale, 1024.0 for green/blue) and packed into one word as R=10 bits, G=11 bits, B=11 bits. The do-while packing loop runs over the vertex count in field +0x1058, and the function returns the conversion-state global dword_8B009C.

Pack red (mask 0x3FF, 10 bits), green (mask 0x7FF, 11 bits) and blue (shifted by 11 then 10) into a single 32-bit word stored through the output pointer v6.
